text: Implement safety guardrails and validation system
description: Build safeguards before irreversible actions: validate transaction parameters, confirm API outputs, detect unsafe operations, abort or retry safely. Include: pre-action validation, destructive operation warnings, rollback mechanisms, safe failure modes, and human escalation for high-risk decisions. Balance autonomy with safety.

status.comment: Cancelled 24 July 2026 as an over-broad subsystem. Validation, warnings, rollback, safe failure, and human escalation should be implemented at concrete risky action boundaries and represented by ordinary aims/statuses—not as a generic guardrails system with no testable workflow. Create a scoped aim when an actual irreversible operation lacks protection.

reflection: The safety intention remains valid, but this aim bundled every safeguard without a target action, threat, or acceptance test. Cancelling the abstraction keeps concrete safety work discoverable and evidence-driven.
